title: 鲸腹遗城：原画风格回归前的当前19房玩法合同
authority: 当前实际工作区的运行代码/场景/合并后的房间表；不是V5.2概念设计的技能获取顺序。

baseline.head: 96f454a943129f750c72dabd10acabc6189eeaeb
baseline.verification_boundary: 本轮只重新运行check/test；原生路线、Web按键和视觉效果需在换图后重新验收，不将前轮截图当本轮美术通过。

counts.counting_note: Enemies counts encounter instances, not swarm individual sprites; ordinary3 crabs +1 amphipod swarm +1 clam, Boss mother crab +3 later-region Bosses.

loader.algorithm: CampaignWorld.load_rooms: duplicate old seven by ID, replace first seven from layout/rooms.json, append world/rooms.json, apply links patches, resolve to_id. Saved index order is append-only.

must_preserve: 角色动作/输入/物理/攻击时序与伤害
19房稳定ID、索引、连接目标及进入条件
技能、奖励、Boss与结局的当前授予来源和顺序
现有碰撞多边形、单向属性、可达跳台、圆环和门点
膜触发区、固定端、形变与碰撞一致
营地/拾取/互动范围、门闩/开态的真实可见性
V6进度兼容、旧检查点安全投影、测试存档隔离
artwork_can_change: 背景、远中近景、位图素材、等比摆放、遮挡和静动表现
与原画一致但不侵入角色运动包络的非碰撞装饰
freeze_policy.hash_policy: Full scene/source hashes identify this snapshot only; visual changes will change scene hash. Compare frozen_geometry_sha256 and gameplay data/code separately to detect unintended behavior changes.
not_authorized_by_this_contract: 新增开关/谜题/敌人/关卡
改移动数值、奖励顺序或碰撞以迁就美术

sources.source: new_game + normalized true on V6 load

sources.opens: R1-04 right door; base dash/slit and dash-unlocked skill group

sources.legacy: collected R1-07 restores float on load

sources.source: R1-05 right exit, before entering R3-01
sources.meaning: first-region milestone, not whole-game ending; unlock rule chapter reads this flag

sources.opens: R3-01 -> R4-01 requires pressure AND anchor

sources.behavior: No key is consumed; persists ending, opens ending page; exploration may continue.

not_hard_gates: R1-05 220px gap supports short-jump+dash and timely double-jump without dash; retain current route choice.
R1-06 far exit target -2 stays closed; do not redirect to unimplemented R2-05.

base_movement: full/short jump; always available second jump; wall slide/jump
anchor acquisition radius390, endpoint at ring+(0,55); anchor travel640; hanging refreshes float
float uses1.02s, target upward speed235, acceleration4400; floor resets budget

A4_parry.actual_use: base forward ranged shot, not the catalog parry action

visuals.timing: Physics/state/skill events select frames; input movement is not baked video translation; per-action animation source is presentation only.
visuals.body_fx_independence: Preserve body/FX anchors, facing and event/landing/release timing; visual frame count must not rewrite hit windows.

player.practice: F9 temporary practice enables all; exits restore snapshot. F10 toggles upgrades only in practice; neither is progression evidence.

runtime_overrides.visual_scale: 94 / alpha-used height of idle source; rendered body target remains94 world pixels

input_bindings.grapple: existing grapple action; base ring targeting remains390px
input_bindings.context_actions: W+attack upper; S+air attack pogo; U directional spells; hold/release attack for charge; V hold>=0.6s for long dash

ordinary_crab.respawn: room reload, not permanent Boss flag
ordinary_crab.attack: low front sweep with terrain occlusion; jump/front/back checks remain
ordinary_crab.visual: authored walking/attack/death atlases; no static duplicate

mother_crab.damage_adapter: campaign amount x10; guarded melee x0.5, ranged x0.25, minimum1
mother_crab.counter: heavy melee in final0.62s of slam tell can bypass guard and stagger; no unavoidable full-height corner finisher

kit_encounters.boss_flags: stable room_id:index; Boss defeat persists, grants configured mark; ordinary enemies reload
kit_encounters.swarm: lane telegraph, horizontal crossing, Boss gathers beside player in recovery; half-health config overrides
kit_encounters.clam: ring tell then aiming pearl projectile(s); body has authored eight-frame cycle with static fallback; pearls are not rebound traversal platforms
kit_encounters.membrane: marks player position with shrinking ring, then pulse hit at marked point; half-health repeats
kit_encounters.do_not_rewrite: Names, HP/hits, config timings/lane/shot counts, hurt rectangles and grant flags are recorded per room below.

doors_and_interactions.entry: E for door/exit; side passage auto-entry uses input direction, armed flag and doorway crossing. No immediate bounce until moving away.

presentation.kit: authored Closed/Open nodes are sole visual owner at height0
presentation.built_exit: kind exit with resolved to>=0 has actual open tunnel; unbuilt to=-1 keeps chapter semantics

doors_and_interactions.camp_behavior: physical E interaction sets checkpoint at player; restores5 health and shield charges; writes V6 progress
doors_and_interactions.kit_interactables: stationary dialogue/state-reading; no new reward, combat or locomotion grant; IDs and flags are recorded per room

membrane.load: on floor in load_rect; time builds to1.3s; smoothstep0.25..0.85, max_drop42, speed85/s; unload1.5x
membrane.collision: room-space bent_polygon and artwork membrane_drop uniform must agree; fixed endpoints remain fixed
membrane.dive: down+jump on loaded membrane (>15 drop) follows authored dive_rect; existing106px dive
membrane.rebound: existing213.75px rebound only inside rebound_rect; preserve world heights
membrane.pause: holds current pose; no duplicate clock or replay catch-up

save_contract.legacy_import: valid version>=6 old WhalefallArtmatchV05 file copied only if target absent; QA/capture does not import
save_contract.old_position_compatibility: CampaignLayout.restore_point preserves safe current lanes, otherwise scales legacy_size then projects to nearest safe checkpoint lane; no save payload rewrite
save_contract.r105_hub_return: Hub retains spawn[1450,563]; layout projects to new exit safe lane near[1475.186,810].
save_contract.deaths: fade retry from checkpoint; ordinary encounter reload and persistent Boss flags retained; R1-05 soft-beds force1 damage and return last_safe before lethal room bounds

regression_plan.command: node tools/godot.mjs check && node tools/godot.mjs test
regression_plan.pass: zero script/ERROR logs; current124 tests pass; cosmetic changes must not silently remove assertions
fresh only anchor; original inputs traverse first five rooms, earn Boss dash, save physical camp, reach R3-01 without health/ability/transform writes
02 vent/memory access, 03 reward/membrane load/dive/rebound, 06 reward/return/far-latch refusal, 07 four-ring outbound+alternate-height return
low roof visible/collision align; short dash lands; recoveries once at1hp cost; timely no-dash double jump retained; hub old spawn safely projects
19-room route/4Boss grants, combination gates, ending and independent-process reload. Existing later-route fixtures prove integration, not whole-game difficulty.

compare seven actual rooms at gameplay scale: grounded feet/deck top, silhouette/collision, supports/walls/roof thickness, doors/relive pickups, root-pinned plants, fish frame+path, bubbles, pause and parallax; art files really loaded

regression_plan.entry: node tools/godot.mjs export-web; isolated server + current browser routes
regression_plan.pass: layout/rooms.json packaged, font covered, real keyboard doors+fade, no automatic fixture grants or real save access; no publish unless separately requested

route_hints.hint: 登上颌骨，再从骨拱下穿出
落入中央须槽，沿对壁回到主路
上路遇骨壁，折入膜下通道再回到出口
曲折骨廊入场，中央展开为战斗空间
低拱与错层相连，冲刺后必须调整落点

doors.message: R2-05远侧闩只能从另一侧开启；请原路返回须筛。

route_hints.hint: 绕中央气道左右交替攀升
围绕中空骨柱上行，背侧取记忆后下层返回

properties.title: 余索 · 旧索与通路
lines: 上面的肺口还通着，先去那边看看。
右侧强流门需要潮压，红索上的固定环会带你过去。
progressed_lines: 潮压稳住了。沿右侧固定环上去，过门就是断脊。
回来时认准这处壳营，旧路还在。

properties.title: 贝驮
lines: 空壳是住处，壳口要留给水流。
别急着搬，先在安全岸边放稳。

route_hints.hint: 胃枢 · 左上肺口通往肺心潮庭；右侧锚环上的强流门需要潮压，过门去断脊
route_hints.about:
胃肠沉城枢纽 · 壳形营地可歇息。
左下返回须门遗港，左上肺口去肺心潮庭，右上强流门通往断脊。

reward.reward_notice: 育囊授予浮游 · 起跳后按住浮游键上升，生命已恢复

properties.title: 育床 · 留给上行者的刻痕
lines: 先跃离膜床，再张开浮膜。
往右上逐台攀升，门后是心室观察台。

route_hints.hint: 育囊授予浮游 · 起跳后按住浮游键，逐台升到右上出口
route_hints.about: 肺心潮庭入口 · 育囊可授予浮游。三级高台只有浮游能上，右上出口通往心室观察台。

route_hints.hint: 心室观察台 · 端足群流横穿前会亮起方向带，站上中间高台避开；右侧通往血巢
route_hints.about: 心包外缘的观察台 · 壳形营地可歇息。右侧出口通往血巢潮群。

enemies.name: 血巢潮群
enemies.defeat_notice: 血巢潮群散去 · 获得潮压，胃枢的强流门已可通行

route_hints.hint: 血巢潮群 · 方向带亮起的那一层即将被横穿，换层躲开；它落回地面时近身攻击
route_hints.about: 心室断壁旁的血巢 · 三层换层台。击败血巢潮群获得潮压。

route_hints.hint: 断脊入口 · 沿骨台向右
route_hints.about: 鸣肋断脊入口 · 强流门的另一侧。向右是上锚路线。

route_hints.hint: 上锚路线 · 鸣贝张开三圈光后吐珠，看准再靠近
route_hints.about: 椎体上外侧的骨台 · 吐珠鸣贝守着中段。右侧通往悬脊鸣贝。

enemies.name: 悬脊鸣贝
enemies.defeat_notice: 悬脊鸣贝沉寂 · 获得骨音，右侧通往交通椎

route_hints.hint: 悬脊鸣贝 · 三圈光亮起后成排吐珠，借高台错开弹道再近身
route_hints.about: 椎旁宽骨台 · 击败悬脊鸣贝获得骨音，右侧通往交通椎。

properties.title: 骨音节点 · 交通椎
lines: 右门通向耳海。潮压、骨音与静默齐备后，从中段下行口前往归海释放槽。
locked_lines: 骨面安静，尚未取得骨音。

route_hints.hint: 交通椎 · 壳形营地可歇息；右侧去头耳，中段下行口去归海释放槽
route_hints.about: 腰尾交界的分流台 · 壳形营地可歇息。右侧通往耳海，中段的下行口通往归海释放槽。

properties.title: 三槽记忆 · 骨面回声
lines: 三槽分别对应潮压、骨音与静默。
取得的标记会在骨槽中亮起。先沿右门去安全池，再向覆膜深处。
progressed_lines: 覆膜后的声槽已显露，静默也回到三槽。
回到交通椎，从中段下行口去释放槽。

route_hints.hint: 耳海入口 · 三槽装置记着潮压、骨音与静默
route_hints.about: 枕骨侧的入口 · 三槽装置对应潮压、骨音与静默。右侧通往安全池。

properties.title: 安全池 · 暂歇
lines: 先在壳营歇息，右门之后是缄声覆膜。
空心回声圈会记住你先前的位置，等它收拢后再移步。

route_hints.hint: 安全池 · 壳形营地可歇息；右侧是缄声覆膜
route_hints.about: 耳骨外周的安全池 · 壳形营地可歇息。右侧通往缄声覆膜。

enemies.name: 缄声覆膜
enemies.defeat_notice: 缄声覆膜退去 · 获得静默。回交通椎，从中段下行口去归海释放槽

route_hints.hint: 缄声覆膜 · 空心圈会收拢在你刚才站的位置，离开它再回头近身
route_hints.about: 覆膜附着的颅底骨面 · 击败缄声覆膜获得静默。

reward.reward_notice: 导流闸打开 · 潮水流向外海

properties.title: 归海释放槽 · 导流闸
lines: 导流闸需要潮压、骨音与静默齐备。
标记不会被消耗。三样齐备后，到右侧导流闸前按交互键。
progressed_lines: 导流闸已经打开，流向外海的路仍在。
可以沿左门返回，继续探索鲸体中的旧路。

route_hints.hint: 归海释放槽 · 潮压、骨音、静默齐备后，在导流闸前按交互键
route_hints.about: 尾柄侧裂处的释放槽 · 三样齐备才能打开导流闸。

environment_progress_behavior.pressure_current: R3-01 strong-current field reads permanent abilities.pressure, smoothly blends velocity/opacity without teleport or pool replacement; preserve pause/reload behavior.
environment_progress_behavior.state_art: KitStateArt reads required_flags with all-of logic; scan_reveal temporarily reveals for4s; does not write flags or change collision.
environment_progress_behavior.larvae: R5-08 has six noncombat instances, independent swimming frames + bounded routes; actual ending flag releases them with smooth acceleration/faded wrap; no health/quest grant.
environment_progress_behavior.residents: Seven stationary interactables across later regions; E/dialogue reads flags, never grants new skills.
